paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R (VR38DETT) – for use with Radium 20-0556-02 fuel rails Part Type: Fuel rail plumbing kit Part Number: 20-0956-PK
The Radium 20-0956-PK plumbing kit is designed to work with Radium's 20-0556-02 fuel rails for the Nissan R35 GT-R. Used together, the rail upgrade becomes a bolt-on, plug-and-play job.
hl: Plug-and-Play: Bolt-on plumbing for the Radium 20-0556-02 R35 GT-R fuel rails
OEM Line Connection: Low-profile 90° 5/16in and 3/8in SAE to 6AN elbows connect the OEM hard lines
Fuel Pressure Regulator: Multi-port FPR with a stainless steel mount
Pulse Dampers: Two FPD-R direct-mount fuel pulse dampers
Pressure Gauge: 0-100 psi fuel pressure gauge with 8AN ORB to 1/8in NPT adapter
PTFE Hoses: Four PTFE fuel hoses run from the regulator to the rear rail ports
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Rail Plumbing Kit for Nissan R35 GT-R
